title: Segmented impact summaries and embargoed changelog playbook for runtime-2026.03
creator: Arjun Patel
description: Goal: Create a playbook and deliverables package that produces tiered (Enterprise / Developer / Public) release communications for runtime-2026.03, enforces an embargo window for sensitive items, and coordinates signoffs across Eng, Docs, Legal, Marketing, Sales/CS, and Design. Emphasis on producing concise impact summaries engineers can author, a single internal one-pager for CS/SE, and localized customer-facing changelogs. This ticket covers drafting, stakeholder review, redaction guidance, and publishing steps.
acceptance_criteria: Customer-facing changelog: three-tier outputs (Enterprise NDA summary, Developer changelog, Public brief) drafted and approved
Internal one-pager: concise impact + migration notes delivered to CS/SE Slack/doc and reviewed by Eng
Legal redaction checklist applied and signed off by Legal
Localization kickoff: translation tasks created for FR/DE/JP and first pass scheduled
Embargo mechanics: embargo window documented, distribution list and release cutoff times defined
Publishing: docs page + release notes published and Marketing announcement scheduled
tasks: Gather per-PR engineering impact blurbs from ENG owners (deadline: 2026-02-22)
Draft developer changelog (technical details, migration notes, breaking changes)
Draft enterprise summary (customer-impact, mitigations, recommended actions)
Draft public brief (high-level improvements and benefits)
Create internal one-pager for CS/SE with sample responses and escalation path
Run Legal/legal-privilege redaction pass and capture required wording changes
Coordinate Design for changelog layout and callouts
Kick off localization with Docs (create translatable content and Po files)
Define embargo schedule and assemble gated distribution list (internal + partner contacts)
Prepare publish checklist and assign publishing owners for docs and website
timeline: 2026-02-15: Ticket created and initial stakeholder sync (PM/ENG/DOC/LEGAL/DSGN)
2026-02-22: Engineering blurbs due; PM to compile draft
2026-02-24: Drafts shared with Legal and Design for first pass
stakeholders: Engineering leads: Priya Rao, Ben Novak
review_flow: Draft -> Eng validation -> Legal redaction -> Design layout -> Marketing messaging -> CS review -> Final signoff (PM + Eng + Legal + Marketing)
signoff_requirements: Marketing messaging and embargo timing (Marketing lead)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Late ENG blurbs delaying legal review -> Mitigation: PM to escalate and accept concise placeholder blurbs for legal redaction
Risk: Confidential items slip into public brief -> Mitigation: Legal maintains a redaction checklist; all public content gated through Legal
Risk: Localization delay for non-EN markets -> Mitigation: Prioritize Enterprise and Developer languages; include fallback English copy in localized pages
Risk: Mismatch between changelog and docs -> Mitigation: Single source of truth in Docs repo; publishing checklist enforces sync
embargo_details: Embargo window: 2026-03-10 00:00 UTC -> 2026-03-12 08:00 UTC (publication allowed after 2026-03-12 08:00 UTC)
Gated list: Marketing managers, Enterprise AMs, Partner PMs, select early-access customers
Embargo breach policy: immediate notify Legal + PM + CTO and rollback publication if needed

notes: Prefer condensed 'what changed' table for developer changelog (component, change, impact, migration) to reduce scan time
Enterprise changelog must include mitigation steps and affected SLAs if any
Keep public brief strictly benefits-focused; no internal flags or technical debt items
